digest.component_or_area: Plan review attestation validity and pin health derivation
propositions: Signed material pins must be validated as the single related-material check across all attestation lifecycle consumers with safe rollout via optional configuration.

Pin drift, missing targets, and malformed records invalidate plan-review attestations when enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled; disabled enforcement reports identical observations as advisory without changing validity.

Health derivation must precede existing early returns in compute_validity to expose pin drift even when cheaper checks control the verdict, while delegation through PlanValidityProfile.DRIFT_REFRESH gates progressive refresh on current pins.
Re-sign recovery must validate review-time related-material pins from the sidecar without requiring a certified attestation, preserving own-material staleness guards.
Reviewed related material must be threaded through full LLM review paths via sidecar.emit and build_payload while idempotent reuse and drift refresh retain existing no-sidecar behavior.
Legacy unpinned attestations and pre-feature sidecars must remain valid across all configuration states and enforcement modes.
